sessionStart.command: node -e "Promise.resolve().then(()=>{const p=require('node:path');let r=process.env.ALTITUDE_CURSOR_PLUGIN_ROOT;if(!r){const c=JSON.parse(require('node:fs').readFileSync(p.join(require('node:os').homedir(),'.cursor','altitude','plugin.json'),'utf8'));if(c.version!==1||c.owner!=='altitude-cursor')throw Error('registration');r=c.pluginRoot}if(typeof r!=='string'||!p.isAbsolute(r))throw Error('root');return import(require('node:url').pathToFileURL(p.join(r,'bin','altitude-cursor-hook.mjs')).href)}).then(m=>m.main('session-start')).catch(()=>{process.stderr.write('Altitude Cursor hook bootstrap unavailable; run Altitude /connect to register the active plugin installation.\n');process.stdout.write('{}\n');process.exitCode=0})"
